This strategic alliance marks a significant milestone in both companies’ histories, combining MBT’s unparalleled distribution network and market expertise with Al Fakher Molasses’ legacy of excellence and innovation in the molasses industry. Together, we aim to redefine standards and enrich the experiences of our customers across the region. At MBT, we have built our reputation on a foundation of reliability, quality, and customer satisfaction. Our partnership with Al Fakher Molasses exemplifies our commitment to enhancing our product offerings and delivering exceptional value to our clients. Stay tuned as we embark on this exciting journey together, setting new benchmarks and achieving greater heights in the tobacco and molasses sectors.
